2026-10-06-term-definition-cleanup-appli.verdict: After four tightenings the term-definition rule passed 40/40 by eye and moved definitions out of <term> on 207,363 pages in 4,911 books (4.0%); 16 pages later corrected.
2026-10-06-term-definition-cleanup-appli.decision: Class d_termdef applied with page_revisions undo rows; the same rule now drives the reader (#5901, #5908)

2026-10-06-translation-reasoning-leak-60.verdict: At least 549 pages in 269 live books carry the model's reasoning or a chat reply as the translation (38/40 by eye); rare, clustered, still being written in Oct 2026.

2026-10-06-translation-write-guard-brack.verdict: A bracket-after-term rule caught supplied words half the time; cut to brackets the sentence names as a term, it fires 0-2 times per ~12.5K stored pages, all glosses.
2026-10-06-translation-write-guard-brack.decision: bracketDefinitionsToNotes runs in the translation write guard (translate-write, #5902)

2026-10-06-typed-editions-ground-truth-c.verdict: Typical body CER 3.3% (Paddle, Siku MS), 2.6% (Gemini, CBETA Chan), 4.7% (Pali vs VRI, mostly edition difference); a pooled model extrapolates within Chinese, not across scripts.

2026-10-06-typed-references-dta-camena-e.verdict: DTA, CAMENA and EEBO-TCP give typed references for 754 of our books (107,252 aligned pages); 35/36 leaves right by eye, 30/38 same-edition claims hold; 211 works get a period English translation.

2026-10-06-untagged-additions-5982.md.verdict: 4.9% [3.3, 7.3] of 450 live pages carry an untagged addition the detector sees, almost all in pre-v10 translations (v13: 0/124); OCR also invents text on 4/86 typed-text pages.

2026-10-06-untried-ocr-engines-wave1-601.verdict: No untried engine beats Gemini 3 Flash outside the margin on any script; Qwen3-VL-8B (Chinese MS), Opus 5.5 (Greek), Sonnet 5.5 (early English) beat lite; none near Yigdzin on Tibetan.
2026-10-06-untried-ocr-engines-wave1-601.decision: No routing change; wave-2 arms (Qwen3-VL-32B, GPT) pending Derek (#6011)

2026-10-07-ai-exposure-run2-6038.md.verdict: For 52.2% [47.4-56.9] of identifiable works no frontier model names the author from the title; "about a third" is retracted for works and holds only for volumes (38.6%) and pages.
2026-10-07-ai-exposure-run2-6038.md.decision: Public wording changed to about half of distinct works, a third of volumes (blog did-the-ai-read-this, #6038)

2026-10-07-ai-exposure-run3-6038.md.verdict: 85.5% of works have no passage of our text in the 2025 public crawls (weak: 64% sensitivity on our OCR); 73.8% already exist publicly as raw OCR; the content-knowledge test failed its controls.
2026-10-07-ai-exposure-run3-6038.md.decision: Claim no crawl absence without the sensitivity clause and no content-knowledge claim (#6038)

2026-10-07-bl-kangyur-chained-retranslat.verdict: Chained re-translation ties the stored flash-v13 English on held BL Kangyur pages (Opus 4.17 vs 4.22, 23 pages) and adds the only inversions; value is in the 26,440 pages with no English.
2026-10-07-bl-kangyur-chained-retranslat.decision: Do not re-translate the 168,815 pages with English; translating the 26,440 without English awaits Derek (#4523)

2026-10-07-bl-tibetan-other-stratum-by-e.verdict: The 993 held no-reference BL Tibetan books read by eye: 9% serious pages (frame-weighted), mostly in the English; 0 wrong leaves, 0 don't-show books, 25 of 28 show with caveat.

2026-10-07-bl-tibetan-terma-biography-pr.verdict: No accuracy figure is possible for held terma/biography manuscripts: 96% of served pages retrieve no open e-text; the 6 on-index pages read at median identity 0.80.

2026-10-07-books-tradition-labels-4773.m.verdict: Flash-lite labelled the tradition of all 109,006 books for $2.74; 27/30 right by eye, 3 arguable, 0 wrong; same family as the pilot's by-eye labels on every non-European shelf.
2026-10-07-books-tradition-labels-4773.m.decision: books.tradition stored on 109,006 books and used by the search tradition re-rank (#4773)

2026-10-07-clef-jev-token-readers-6184.m.verdict: Neither Clef (61% on 36 disputed one-mark Sanskrit slots, 22% order flips) nor Jev (39%) meets the 80% bar as an independent tie-break reader.
2026-10-07-clef-jev-token-readers-6184.m.decision: Neither adopted as the #6203 tie-break; it stays a person or a transcribing reader (#6203)

2026-10-07-concept-lane-stage1.md.verdict: On the same 1,216 books the concept-abstract lane adds +0.60 [0.16, 1.00] relevant traditions in the top ten over page vectors, with no loss of precision; smaller than the pilot's +1.12.
2026-10-07-concept-lane-stage1.md.decision: Stage-1 abstract lane serves conceptPageSearch in /api/search; corpus-wide pass (~$530) waits for human-written queries (#6173)

2026-10-07-embedding-format-ga.md.verdict: GA and preview embeddings are bit-identical; query prefix alone loses (B R@10 0.97 to 0.84); prefix on both sides helps but misses the bar at the ceiling; more dims gain nothing.
2026-10-07-embedding-format-ga.md.decision: No prefix, no re-embed, stay at 768 dims; larger follow-up test run (#6170)

2026-10-07-embedding-granularity-cross-t.verdict: A per-page concept abstract lane was the only index change to clear the bar: relevant traditions in the top ten 1.68 to 2.80 (+1.12 [0.60, 1.64]); chunks and query rewriting did not.
2026-10-07-embedding-granularity-cross-t.decision: Concept lane stage 1 built (1,216 books) and serving search; corpus-wide pass held (#6173)

2026-10-07-embedding-models-qwen3-dual.m.verdict: No re-embed clears the bar: dual Gemini vectors gain nothing on B, Qwen3-8B wins A (+0.05) but ties B; 16% of stored vectors drift from their own text (cos < 0.9).
2026-10-07-embedding-models-qwen3-dual.m.decision: No new model or dual vectors; repair off-space and drifted rows instead (#6175)

2026-10-07-embedding-prefix-100k.md.verdict: On a 100K pool the prefix on both sides lifts cross-lingual R@10 0.58 to 0.97 but misses the bar on set B by one query (+0.039); query prefix alone and mixed stores lose.
2026-10-07-embedding-prefix-100k.md.decision: No re-embed on this evidence; re-score with human-written set-B questions before deciding (#6170)
